concerns.text: FR-002 mandates measuring energy 'excluding system idle time' but provides no verifiable procedure or metric definition for how 'idle time' is identified or subtracted. Without a deterministic rule (e.g., 'subtract baseline power measured during a 10s no-op loop'), this requirement is untestable.

FR-005 requires a 'log-log regression analysis' but does not specify the dependent/independent variables or the statistical method (e.g., OLS, robust regression). 'Fitting a relationship' is not a verifiable functional requirement without defining the exact model equation or output format.

SC-004 sets a success threshold of 'standard deviation ... within 15% of the mean' but does not define the scope of this measurement (e.g., per configuration, per model size, or global). A global average might pass while individual configurations fail, making the criterion ambiguous and unmeasurable.

FR-001 lists 'LLaMA 7B' as a required model to load. However, User Story 1 (P1) and the Assumptions section explicitly state that the 7B model will likely exceed memory limits and be 'skipped' or 'fail gracefully'. The requirement to 'load and execute' contradicts the defined failure mode, making it impossible to verify 'success' for this specific item without redefining the requirement to 'attempt load'.
